title: Payment-History Credit on Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease TRAC Deficiencies
content:
# Collections Credit Schedule — Payment History and the TRAC Deficiency, Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease

**Schedule.** For the deficiency billed on a TRAC unit of the Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease whose sale settlement falls short of its book value, the deficiency payment-history credit is $100 where the unit's ledger shows no late charge posted within the last 12 whole months, $50 where it shows exactly one, and nothing where it shows two or more.

**Records read.** The late charges posted on this unit's own ledger and their posting dates. A late charge falls within the last 12 whole months when fewer than 12 whole months separate its posting date from today; whole months are one fewer where today's day of the month is smaller than the posting's.

| Late charges on the unit within the last 12 whole months | Payment-history credit |
|---|---|
| none | $100 |
| exactly one | $50 |
| two or more | nothing |

## Cases (hypothetical)

1. One late charge on the unit posted 13 whole months ago and none since: none within the window, $100.
2. One late charge posted 3 whole months ago: $50.
3. Late charges posted 2 and 7 whole months ago: nothing.
4. Late charges on other units of the same business are not read.
